candidates.name: Siemens AG
candidates.description: Both are global technology leaders providing extensive solutions in industrial automation, electrification, and infrastructure digitalization.
candidates.rationale: Siemens directly overlaps ABB in industrial automation, electrification, motion/control systems, and infrastructure digitalization for the same industrial buyers.

candidates.name: Hitachi, Ltd.
candidates.description: Both companies operate large-scale portfolios spanning industrial systems, power grid technology, and digital infrastructure solutions.
candidates.rationale: Hitachi offers industrial automation, energy and grid technologies that overlap ABB’s core portfolio and target the same industrial and utility buyers.

candidates.name: Legrand Group

candidates.name: Schneider Electric

candidates.rationale: Schneider Electric directly overlaps ABB in electrification, energy management, and industrial automation, serving the same industrial, infrastructure, and building buyers.

candidates.name: Eaton

candidates.name: Rockwell Automation, Inc.

candidates.name: Emerson

candidates.rationale: Emerson overlaps ABB in industrial automation, control systems, and software, serving the same manufacturing and process-industry buyers.

candidates.name: Honeywell International, Inc.

candidates.name: Danfoss

candidates.name: Bosch Rexroth AG
